svg.title: Anatomy of an HTML order email and where each part is changed
svg.desc: A sketch of an order email on the left with five horizontal bands, from top to bottom: the header with logo and heading, the introduction written by the template, the order details table, the customer details and the additional content, and the footer. Each band is linked to the hook that prints it and, on the right, to the place where a store owner or developer changes it: the Emails settings screen for logo, colours and footer text, the per-email settings for subject, heading and additional content, a theme template override for the introduction, hooks for the order table and customer details, and the email styles filter for CSS.
svg.text: Anatomy of an order email and where to change each part
Layout of the "Processing order" and "Roast ready" HTML emails; plain text follows the same order without styling

g.text: logo and width, header alignment, font family, colours;
per email: subject, heading, preheader, type, Cc and Bcc
or edit the email in the block email editor when it is enabled
add_action on woocommerce_email_order_meta for one extra line;
filter woocommerce_email_order_items_table for the item rows
core templates call the hooks in the same order everywhere
text below the main content, placeholders such as {store_email}
checkout fields registered with the Additional Checkout Fields
API are printed by core; classic filters are for shortcode checkout
footer text setting; extra CSS through woocommerce_email_styles,
inlined into each element because mail clients ignore most style sheets

svg.text: Placeholders such as {site_title}, {site_url} and {store_email} are replaced in the subject, heading, additional content and footer text.
